title: Basic invariants for time-like surfaces in $\mathbb R^3_1$ with real asymptotic lines
summary: The geometrically defined wide class of time-like surfaces in $\mathbb R^3$, admitting real asymptotic lines is considered. A fundamental theorem of Bonnet-type is obtained for these surfaces. It states that a surface in this class is determined (up to a motion) by four invariant functions, satisfying some natural PDEs.
